title: Target Restriction of a Switching Trace
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates and let a switching trace for $\varphi$ start at restriction $\rho$. Its target is a coordinate-state assignment: for a final trace, it is the satisfying extension of the canonical compatible term using the chosen positions; for a recursive trace, it is the satisfying extension of the canonical compatible term at the current restriction, applied to the tail's target and using all currently free literal positions.
hypotheses_covered: A switching trace for that formula, with its starting restriction
